_comment: Copy this to dev-host.local.json (gitignored) and replace the placeholder with this machine's tailnet MagicDNS name — find it with `tailscale status`. The dev server refuses to start while the placeholder is still here, so a half-finished copy cannot silently serve on the wrong host list. One-off alternative: ROBCO_DEV_HOST=your-machine.tailXXXXXX.ts.net npm run dev
